t: GitHub - ttempaa/bun-plugin-glob-import: A Bun plugin that enables importing modules using glob patterns
s: This plugin allows you to import modules using glob patterns.

Bun also implements Node.js’s fs.glob() functions with additional features: Copy · import { glob, globSync, promises } from "node:fs"; // Array of patterns const files = await promises.glob(["**/*.ts", "**/*.js"]); // Exclude patterns const filtered = await promises.glob("**/*", { exclude: ["node_modules/**", "*.test.*"], }); All three functions (fs.glob(), fs.globSync(), fs.promises.glob()) support: Array of patterns as the first argument ·
